info.name: DBL HRM API
info.description: Full API surface for the DBL HRM backend (manpower requisition & hiring lifecycle). Run "Auth → Login" first — it saves the JWT into the {{token}} collection variable automatically, which every other request uses via Bearer auth. Routes marked as no-auth in their folder (Public - ...) don't need a token. Path segments like :id are Postman path variables — fill them in the "Path Variables" tab or edit the URL directly.

request.description: Employee code or admin email as identifier. Saves the JWT into {{token}} automatically.
